title: Update all Snap packages
summary: Manually refresh all installed snap packages to their latest versions.

steps.explain: Refresh all installed snaps to the latest available versions.
steps.expect: Progress bars for each snap being updated.

rollback.explain: Snaps are updated automatically by default. To revert a specific snap to a previous revision, use 'sudo snap revert <SNAP_NAME>'.
rollback.gui: Open a terminal and run: sudo snap revert <SNAP_NAME>

warnings: Snaps are refreshed automatically according to the snap refresh.timer setting.
